notes.title: Update 1.0.6
notes.content:
This update provides another small batch of level adjustments, designed to remove unintended solutions from levels. As before, we have tried to keep the changes as small as possible, staying true to the original levels.

Here's a list of all the levels that have been adjusted:
[list]
[*] Pack 3: levels 17, 23, 30
[*] Pack 4: levels 4, 13, 27, 28
[*] Pack 5: levels 20, 31
[/list]
We also added an additional hint to the following level (since analytics data suggests it is one of the most difficult ones):
[list]
[*] Pack 3: level 24
[/list]
Please let us know if you discover any "suspicious" solutions after this update and best of luck on your expedition!

GAMEDIA

notes.title: Update 1.0.5
notes.content:
This update provides a number of level adjustments. With more players progressing further into the game, some new unintended solutions have shown up in the analytics data. As before, we have tried to keep the changes as small as possible, staying true to the original levels.

Here's a list of all the levels that have been adjusted:
[list]
[*] Pack 2: level 8
[*] Pack 3: levels 24, 30
[*] Pack 4: levels 28
[*] Pack 5: levels 7, 23, 31
[/list]
Other fixes:
[list]
[*] Special treasures no longer stop sparkling after the squid releases them
[/list]
Let us know if any of the solutions you discover still seem "suspicious". Good luck on your search for treasure!

GAMEDIA
